description: Blocks launching a dev server / dev-watch process (npm run dev, vite, next dev, ...) while the effective working directory (event cwd, adjusted for a literal leading `cd <dir> &&` prefix in the same command) sits on an ENROLLED repo's DEFAULT branch. Closes a real gap: a dev server's own writes (HMR output, a preview/codegen generator) can corrupt tracked files in the shared checkout with no Edit/Write tool call or git command for the sibling hooks (worktree-only-writes, pin-primary-worktree) or Claude Code's own built-in worktree-isolation Bash guard (git-command-focused) to see. ON BY DEFAULT where a rig.yaml exists: shares the SAME agent_hooks.worktree_only knob as the sibling hooks (env RIG_WORKTREE_ONLY=0 or rig.yaml agent_hooks.worktree_only:false opts out; formerly default OFF). Deliberately scoped to a fixed, well-known list of dev-server launch commands only — NOT a general Bash-file-mutation detector (git commit/rm/redirection were considered and rejected as too false-positive-prone for a static parser; see the hook's own module docstring). No self-service env-var bypass; a genuine one-off need requests a one-time Telegram approval via RIG_HATCH_REQUEST_BLOCK_DEVSERVER_PRIMARY="<justification>" (deny-by-default; a bare 1 is rejected). timeout_ms 960000 mirrors the sibling hooks' headroom over tg-ctl ask's 900s cap; a Claude Code settings entry launching cc_hook_bridge must also set timeout >960s. on_error=open: a git/parse failure fails open (allows) — workflow discipline, not a security boundary.
